name: Menu
purpose: A Helix-styled, portaled popup listbox anchored to a trigger element — the internal primitive Select uses instead of a native <select> dropdown, and the foundation for any future popup list (Combobox, a context menu, a DatePicker's own internals).
neverUseFor: A standalone navigable menu bar — this is a single anchored popup list, not a menubar widget
Content that isn't a flat or single-level-grouped list of choices — this is a listbox, not a generic popover
rationale: Menu is the hand-rolled, portaled listbox (ADR-013) that Select and MultiSelect use instead of a native <select> popup, so options can be styled with tokens and rendered in the top layer. Rows are semantic.size.m (32px) to match field triggers, and keyboard handling lives in the consumer's trigger so one primitive serves every future popup list.

mayExtendLocally: Supply options and groups through the documented props
Build new DS popup lists (Combobox, context menu) on top of Menu
mustEscalateToDS: Using Menu as a generic popover or a menubar
Changing row height, portaling or anchoring behavior

authored.name: expanded
authored.description: Whether the popup is currently rendered and visible.

anatomy.description: Root popup surface. `role="listbox"`. Portaled to document.body.
Full-width divider before a group, except the first one (nothing above it to separate from). `role="separator"`. Bleeds edge-to-edge past the menu's own padding.
Non-interactive label for a group of options. Uses semantic.textStyle.label-uppercase, no added letter-spacing.
Optional labelEnd: short secondary text on the option's end edge, muted, tabular figures. Takes the selected/disabled color with its option.

props.name: id
props.description: Listbox element id, referenced by the consumer's trigger via aria-controls/aria-activedescendant.

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: The trigger element the menu positions itself against.

props.name: options
props.description: Flat options or grouped options: { value, label, labelEnd?, disabled? } or { label, options }. labelEnd renders on the option's end edge (menu-item-label-end).

props.name: value
props.description: Currently selected value, for aria-selected + visual highlight.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Multi-selection (ADR-019): aria-multiselectable on the listbox, every value in `values` marked aria-selected. `value` is ignored when set.

props.name: activeValue
props.description: Keyboard-highlighted value (not yet selected) — the consumer owns keyboard nav on its trigger and passes this down; Menu renders the highlight and exposes ids for aria-activedescendant.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Fires when an option is clicked.

height.note: Each option row is semantic.size.m (32px). The popup's own height is intrinsic to its option count, not fixed.

width.default: The anchor's (trigger's) width — not driven by a semantic token per CLAUDE.md's width policy (variable, consumer/component judgment call, no system token for it).
width.note: Rule: 150px minimum when the options are words, so a narrow trigger (Select has no minimum) doesn't squeeze them. No minimum when every option is a number (1, 2, 1000, 2000…) — Menu sets data-numeric on its root in that case.

keyboardNav: Handled by the consumer's trigger, not Menu itself — Menu is presentational plus click-to-select. See Select's own contract for the actual Arrow/Home/End/typeahead handling.

properties.name: state
properties.description: On MenuItem: hover also covers the keyboard-active option ([data-active]); selected = aria-selected (fill/primary light, text/primary, Body / m / Medium); disabled = text/disabled.

figma.structure: MenuItem set composed into a Menu component: 1px border/neutral (in the layout), 4px top/bottom padding, radius/m, shadow / m, 240px (menu.width). Groups: menu-group (4px sides) > menu-group-label (Label / Uppercase, 12/12/4 padding; 12px top only on the first group = 16 − the menu's 4) + options 2px apart; menu-group-divider edge to edge with 8px above and 16px below. Measured identical to code (Grouped story, 223px tall).
